window-1.title: Pointer Pointer
window-1.blurb: Someone shot hundreds of photos of people pointing just so a stranger could point at your cursor — that's the exact ratio of absurd effort to dumb payoff you live for.

window-2.title: Type of Culture
window-2.blurb: A one-woman design newsletter that reads type, pop culture and graphic ephemera as one big ongoing conversation — and just rebranded itself mid-run, which is the most Melany move imaginable.

window-3.title: Agua Fresca
window-3.blurb: It's less a recipe than a formula — blend whatever fruit is ripe with lime and water — so you can make a different jewel-toned pitcher every week and never repeat yourself.

window-4.title: Home Tour: Tove Jansson's Helsinki atelier
window-4.blurb: The Moomins were born in this cluttered, paint-stained attic tower and it's been left almost exactly as she lived in it — proof that the best rooms are just a creative brain turned inside out.

window-5.title: Bibik Violet, Temasek Shophouse
window-5.blurb: Grandma-matriarch energy in café form — vintage Peranakan tiles, tasselled lamps, sugee cake and kopi roasted the old way, basically a lived-in heritage mood board you can eat in.
